confidence_notes: Food anchors use Zermatt cost-of-living data; drink anchors use a small sample of current local menus, with the cocktail estimate near 1.7 times the local draft-beer price and wine anchored to local by-the-glass listings. Accommodation is a holistic estimate for a high-cost Alpine resort and is highly season-dependent.
comparable_city_reasoning: No close city comparator used; Zermatt is treated as a high-cost Swiss Alpine resort, with local food and drink prices anchoring those estimates.
